title: evbuilder-update-page-layout.html
content: The new {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} is enabled by default, but its tab will not be visible the first time you use it. To make the tab visible, a Salesforce System Administrator must complete the steps below. Add the Tab Click the {{variable.Button_GearIcon}} in the upper right-hand corner. Click {{variable.Button_Setup}} . Type and click “App Manager” in the Quick Find box.   Locate Events (Admin) app. Use the dropdown arrow on the right to click {{variable.Button_SF_Edit}} for the Classic or Lightning Events (Admin).   Select Navigation Items .   Select and move the Event Builder tab from Available Items to Selected Items.   Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Repeat steps 4 - 10 for the Events (Organizer) app and any other custom Event apps. Add the Button Click the {{variable.Button_GearIcon}} in the upper right-hand corner. Click {{variable.Button_Setup}} . Click the Object Manager tab. Search for and click “Event”. ( Make sure to select the conference360__Event__c object, not the standard Salesforce Event object. )   Click Page Layouts . Click Event Layout . Click Mobile & Lightning Actions .   Remove the Wizard button from the page layout.   Add the {{variable.Button_EventBuilder}} button to the page layout. Repeat steps 5 - 9 for any custom page layouts. Once the tab and button are added, the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} can be accessed via the tab or an {{variable.Object_Event}} record’s {{variable.Button_EventBuilder}} button.
